note: Channel-scoped authorization for publishing outside this server. The standing rule (owner decision 2026-08-30) is that Libra posts nothing automatically. This file does not lift that rule; it lets the owner open exactly one channel. Fail closed: authorized requires authorized_by AND authorized_at.
how_to_authorize: Set authorized true and fill authorized_by and authorized_at (ISO-8601) for the one channel being opened. Remove them to close it again.

pinterest-rss.scope: Serve /libra/growth/feed.xml so Pinterest's native RSS auto-publishing can create Pins from QA-approved hub articles. Covers serving the feed only: it does not authorize ads, paid promotion, DMs, posting to any other network, or any KDP action.
